name: popsicle
headline: n8n Routing Agent Marketing Workflow
short_description: n8n workflow automating AI-powered content generation for marketing copy, blog posts, and cold emails. Ideal for agencies, businesses, and content teams scaling production.
author: javasigma

sections.overview:
This n8n workflow automates content creation using intelligent AI agent routing to generate marketing copy, SEO-optimized blog posts, and outreach emails. A primary router agent directs requests to specialized agents: BlogWriterAgent for long-form articles, CopywriterAgent for landing pages and product descriptions, and ColdEmailAgent for prospecting campaigns. The system processes inputs via web forms, stores data using vector embeddings with HuggingFace integration, and validates outputs with JSON schema enforcement. Marketing agencies can scale client content production, businesses reduce creation costs while maintaining brand consistency, and content teams streamline editorial workflows. Final content is automatically stored in Google Drive, enabling 24/7 content production across multiple channels.
Scale content production for multiple clients at marketing agencies
Generate SEO-optimized blog posts for consistent publishing schedules
Create high-conversion cold email campaigns for sales outreach
Produce landing page copy and product descriptions quickly
